tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all admitted sectors. Generic sectors are fully publishable and discoverable.

tools.name: get_category_schema
tools.description: Get category-specific fields before publishing or filtering. Missing facts must remain unknown.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search public owner-declared and source-attributed imported products, services and providers. Results include provenance and confirmation dates; owner assertions are not independent verification.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Read one public listing by stable ID.

tools.name: my_listings
tools.description: Read your listings including drafts and withdrawn entries. Requires an owner-authorised write API key.

tools.name: publish_listing
tools.description: Publish an offer on behalf of its owner. Requires owner-authorised write API key and attestRights=true. Obtain the category schema first. Publication is free.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Replace your listing using its current expectedVersion. Reconfirm only after checking the actual information. Do not refresh dates without an actual check.
